items.title: Jed York's suspension ends today
items.text: York returns after a six-game ban and $500,000 fine.

items.title: Joe Brady says Bills won't be cutting C.J. Gardner-Johnson after spitting incident
items.text: The two players involved in spitting incidents during games were (and still are) star players.

items.title: Sean McVay on Kyren Williams: "He was emotional after the game"
items.text: After Sunday's loss to the previously 1-4 Cardinals, Rams running back Kyren Williams had a simple explanation for the team's inconsistency on offense.

items.title: Seahawks-Broncos in Week 6 draws 16.26 million on Prime Video
items.text: Although an unresolved question lingers regarding whether or not the numbers are inflated by anyone who visits Amazon Prime and gets an autoplay video of the game, the official, Nielsen-generated numbers for Prime Video's Thursday Night Football keep improving.

items.title: Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans injury is not a long-term thing, hopeful he can play Sunday
items.text: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans had to leave Monday night's game because he aggravated the Achilles injury he has been dealing with, but coach Kyle Shanahan said after the game that they're optimistic Evans will play on Sunday against the Falcons.

items.title: Dan Quinn on viral clip: "I definitely knew it was fourth down"
items.text: The first half of Monday night's game included a failed fourth-and-two play by the Commanders from the San Francisco 13.

items.title: NFL has until Tuesday to decide whether to flex Eagles-Commanders out of prime time
items.text: With the Eagles slipping to 2-4 and the Commanders sliding to 1-4-1, the two teams have a Week 8 prime-time date looming.

items.title: What's next for Dan Quinn?
items.text: At the end of the first half of Monday night's game, with the Commanders down 20-3 and coach Dan Quinn going viral based on a lip-reading clip that was being widely interpreted as him not realizing it was fourth down (after a failed fourth-down play), it looked like Quinn was on track to get fired after the game.

items.title: Monday Night Football: 49ers hang on for 23-17 win over Commanders
items.text: The Commanders had two drives deep into San Francisco territory to win it in the final two minutes.

items.title: Steelers to sign WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling to practice squad
items.text: The Steelers are re-signing veteran wide receiver Marquez Valdes-Scantling, Mike DeFabo of TheAthletic.com reports.

items.title: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin carted with knee injury
items.text: The team has ruled out McLaurin, who was injured in the first quarter.

items.title: Jim Harbaugh on Mike McDaniel: "We're looking into everything"
items.text: Chargers offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel remains employed, for now.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey's TD run has 49ers up 13-3
items.text: The 49ers have started red hot on offense.

items.title: Malik Mustapha avoids another flag for hit on defenseless player, but a second fine is likely
items.text: For the second straight game, 49ers safety Malik Mustapha has avoided a flag for an illegal hit on a defenseless receiver.

items.title: OT Morgan Moses, WR A.J. Brown limited on Patriots' estimated report

items.title: The goal of team doctors shouldn't be to help players "be available"
items.text: Doctors need to treat players as patients, regardless of whether that means they won't be able to play.

items.title: Josh Jacobs to get full week of practice, game status to be determined
items.text: The Packers won't have defensive end Micah Parsons back at practice this week, but they will have running back Josh Jacobs on the field as they prepare to face the Lions.

items.title: Raiders cut OL Evan Neal from the practice squad
items.text: The Raiders cut offensive lineman Evan Neal from their practice squad on Monday, the team announced.

items.title: Rams WR Davante Adams out 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
